### With a PC

#### USB4

Connect chestnut to your computer and use it like any other USB4 dock.

#### USB3 or USB2

Use tinygrad to access the GPU over a USB3 or USB2 connection.

#### Mac

Follow the TinyGPU setup guide to use a supported GPU on macOS.

Join the #gpu-on-usb channel on the tinygrad Discord .
